purpose: Test one fixed family-relative candidate rule against the previously observed adapted-score scale mismatch, using the same qualified two-video RCM policy scope.
mechanism_contract: For each current candidate family (EXISTING and KNOWN), standardize adapted similarity by that family's own mean and population standard deviation; compare the two family peak z-scores. Select the existing peak on a deterministic tie in favor of existing; otherwise emit NEW. No hand-selected similarity threshold or score sweep is allowed.
selection_rule: Use the first two frozen policy-order videos and the first two metadata clock frames of each; no score, label, coverage, or result selection.
interpretation: A positive support-group result is bounded causal lifecycle evidence for this fixed mechanism only; it is not trained memory, independent calibration, predicted-track qualification, an OCD/MOT metric, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
